constraint_prompts.purpose: the poem's own lines are verified and timed to this reel
constraint_prompts.prompt: What we The vape gathers, inside and out. My vision blurs. I move toward the window — and you only get further away. More haze. It was the maze, constructed by a tainted love. You fall off the fire escape, into darkness — and the city streaks upward like it I trip on my own words, falling out of life — and find where you go when you leave. The gap between us breathes, and never closes.
